name: Stretch Table Cover (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
descriptionHtml:
Create a clean, professional presentation with our Stretch Table Cover, designed to deliver edge-to-edge (full bleed) branding with a sleek, wrinkle-free fit. Perfect for trade shows, events, vendor booths, and promotions, this cover transforms standard tables into polished brand displays.

Printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on Power Stretch polyester material, your artwork appears vibrant, sharp, and long-lasting. A rear zipper closure ensures a snug, tailored fit that stays in place throughout your event while maintaining a smooth, professional look.

This stretch table cover is available in 4ft, 6ft, and 8ft table sizes, making it easy to match your setup. Each cover includes a convenient carry bag for easy transport and storage.

🔹 Key Features

🧵 Power Stretch Polyester Fabric – Durable, wrinkle-resistant, and form-fitting
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Vibrant, fade-resistant custom graphics
🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge branding coverage
🔒 Rear Zipper Closure – Secure, snug fit with a clean finish
📏 Multiple Size Options – Available for 4ft, 6ft, and 8ft tables
🧳 Carry Bag Included – Easy transport and storage
⚙️ Easy Setup – Slip-on design for fast installation

🔹 Available Sizes & Dimensions

📐 Standard 8ft Table
96"W × 30"H × 30"D

📐 Standard 6ft Table
72"W × 30"H × 30"D

📐 Standard 4ft Table
48"W × 30"H × 24"D

⚠️ Dimensions may vary slightly depending on table style.

🔹 Fits Approx. Table Sizes

8' Fitted: 96"W × 30"H × 30"D
6' Fitted: 72"W × 30"H × 30"D
4' Fitted: 48"W × 30"H × 24"D

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Stretch Polyester Blend

🔹 Compatibility

📐 Designed to fit standard event tables (size options available)


🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
